character_images_needed: Snake from Can I Play Too
notes: This is a Mo Willems Elephant and Piggie book. The core joke revolves around Snake wanting to join in playing catch but having no arms — 'arms' is therefore a critical fringe word. Gerald and Piggie are highly recognisable named characters and will not be adequately represented by generic Boardmaker elephant or pig symbols. The snake character is also a named recurring device but is generic enough that a standard snake PNG from the library may suffice if a sourced version is unavailable. 'Try' is included because Gerald and Piggie encourage Snake to try anyway, which is a key social-emotional message of the book.
